title: Native backend operations: pools, health, overload, TLS, HSTS, connection names
why: Production deployments behave differently: health checks have two endpoints, overload answers 503 with Retry-After, remote databases need verified TLS and Postgres connections are named per role.
changelog: `brain backend serve` uses separate HTTP and worker pools
steps: Point load-balancer and orchestrator health checks at GET /health/ready (readiness) and GET /health/live (liveness).
